# QuickJS-ng, vendored. Static library only (no qjs/qjsc, no quickjs-libc: LucyN supplies its own host APIs).
# Plain C, so this works even though the rest of LucyN is C++.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
if(NOT TARGET lucyn_quickjs)
  if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(lucyn_quickjs_vendor LANGUAGES C)
  else()
    enable_language(C)
  endif()
  add_library(lucyn_quickjs STATIC dtoa.c libregexp.c libunicode.c quickjs.c)
  add_library(lucyn::quickjs ALIAS lucyn_quickjs)
  target_include_directories(lucyn_quickjs PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_compile_definitions(lucyn_quickjs PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
  set_target_properties(lucyn_quickjs PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_EXTENSIONS ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(lucyn_quickjs PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601)
  else()
    target_link_libraries(lucyn_quickjs PUBLIC m)
  endif()
  find_package(Threads)
  if(Threads_FOUND)
    target_link_libraries(lucyn_quickjs PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
  endif()
  if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(lucyn_quickjs PRIVATE -w)   # upstream code: not ours to fix
  endif()
endif()
